post.description:
Password login: throttled per email and IP, rejects foreign origins and emails of SSO-enforcing
domains, issues a new session.
Revoke the current session and clear the cookies.
Revoke every session of the user (MFA-gated like any other endpoint) and clear the cookies.
Turn MFA off with a TOTP code, unless any of the user's orgs requires MFA.
Turn MFA on with a code from the pending secret; returns 10 recovery codes (shown once).
Start (or restart) enrolment: a new pending TOTP secret, stored encrypted, MFA still off.
Pass MFA for the current session with a TOTP code or a recovery code (which is used up).
Change the password of a recently signed-in user; their other sessions are revoked.
Email a password reset link when the account exists and is active (3 per hour); always 200.
Set a new password from a reset link, sign the user out everywhere, and clear the login lock.
Email a new verification link (3 per hour); nothing is sent once the email is verified.
